name: KDJ Expert Advisor
summary: This EA trades based on the KDJ indicator (Stochastic variant with J-line), generating buy signals when K and D lines cross upward in oversold zones and sell signals when they cross downward in overbought zones. It uses the J-line as a confirming signal for momentum shifts and executes market orders with configurable lot sizing. The strategy aims to capture momentum reversals at extreme KDJ readings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于KDJ指标（带J线的随机指标变体）进行交易，在超卖区域K线和D线向上交叉时产生买入信号，在超买区域向下交叉时产生卖出信号。它利用J线作为动量转变的确认信号，并以可配置的手数执行市价订单。该策略旨在捕捉极端KDJ读数时的动量反转。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用KDJ指标作为核心交易信号源，KDJ是随机指标的变体，增加了J线（3K-2D）来增强敏感性。入场条件为：做多时，K线和D线在超卖区域（通常低于20）发生金叉，且J线从低位拐头向上；做空时，K线和D线在超买区域（通常高于80）发生死叉，且J线从高位拐头向下。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或固定的止损止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，缺少基于账户余额或风险百分比的动态仓位调整。资金管理方面较为简单，没有包含资金比例计算或最大持仓限制。整体策略属于典型的动量反转交易，适合震荡行情但在强趋势中可能产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the KDJ indicator as its core signal source, where KDJ is a variant of the Stochastic oscillator that adds a J-line (3K-2D) for increased sensitivity. Entry conditions are: for long positions, the K and D lines form a golden cross in the oversold zone (typically below 20) with the J-line turning upward from low levels; for short positions, the K and D lines form a death cross in the overbought zone (typically above 80) with the J-line turning downward from high levels. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach, lacking dynamic sizing based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management is relatively simplistic, without equity proportion calculations or maximum position limits. The overall strategy is a typical momentum reversal trading system, suitable for ranging markets but likely to generate frequent false signals during strong trends.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

pros: KDJ指标加入J线提高了信号灵敏度，能更早捕捉动量变化
策略逻辑清晰简洁，参数可配置性强，便于优化和调整
超买超卖区域过滤减少了震荡行情中的虚假信号
入场条件结合了区域过滤和交叉确认，具有一定的可靠性
代码结构相对简单，便于理解和二次开发
pros_en: The KDJ indicator's J-line increases signal sensitivity, capturing momentum shifts earlier
Clear and concise strategy logic with highly configurable parameters for optimization and tuning
Overbought/oversold zone filtering reduces false signals in ranging markets
Entry conditions combining zone filtering with crossover confirmation provide reasonable reliability
Relatively simple code structure, easy to understand and further develop
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动性调整风险敞口
缺少止损止盈的默认设置可能导致无限亏损风险
KDJ在强趋势市场中容易产生频繁的虚假反转信号
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能导致入场成本过高
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit at zero may lead to unlimited loss risk
KDJ tends to generate frequent false reversal signals in strong trending markets
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
Lack of spread filter may result in excessive entry costs in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理，根据ATR或固定风险比例计算手数
添加新K线检查和点差过滤，防止重复开仓和高成本入场
引入趋势过滤器（如均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage, calculating lots from ATR or fixed risk ratio
Implement new bar check and spread filter to prevent duplicate entries and high-cost entries
Introduce a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend trading in strong trends

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，存在无限亏损风险
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一根K线重复开仓
固定手数无法适应不同账户规模和市场波动
没有最大持仓限制，极端情况下可能过度暴露
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit at zero poses unlimited loss risk
No new bar check may cause duplicate position opening on the same bar
Fixed lot sizing cannot adapt to different account sizes and market volatility
No maximum position limit, potentially leading to overexposure in extreme conditions
